task.title: Flash of content in My cards view on mouseout
task.description: When hovering a card row in My cards, a popup shows a small preview of the card art, which works fine. But then when my mouse leaves the target area, I see a brief flash of content that appears to be the card preview rendering inside the row instead of a hovering modal, causing the row to resize to hold the card image, then the image is quickly removed the the row resizes again back to normal.
